# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def decide(observation, memory):
    """Use safety gating, confidence confirmation, and hysteretic target steering."""

    memory = dict(memory or {})
    state = memory.get("state", "IDLE")
    last_turn = memory.get("last_turn", "VEER_LEFT")
    scan_direction = memory.get("scan_direction", "SCAN_LEFT")

    visible = bool(observation["target_visible"])
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    distance = observation["target_distance_class"]
    target_confidence = float(observation["target_confidence"])
    identity_confidence = float(observation["target_identity_confidence"])
    track_age = int(observation["track_age"])
    lost_steps = int(observation["lost_steps"])
    safety_confidence = float(observation["safety_confidence"])
    closing_risk = float(observation["closing_risk"])
    heading_error = abs(float(observation["heading_error"]))

    # Safety is an unconditional hard gate.
    if safety_confidence < 0.60 or closing_risk >= 0.75:
        memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
        return "STOP", 0.99, memory

    confirmed = (
        visible
        and target_confidence >= 0.55
        and identity_confidence >= 0.60
    )

    if not confirmed:
        if state in {"LOCKED", "APPROACH", "VERIFY", "REACQUIRE"} or lost_steps:
            memory["state"] = "REACQUIRE"
            if lost_steps <= 1:
                return "STOP", 0.92, memory

        # Keep each scan direction for two frames to reduce scan oscillation.
        if lost_steps % 2 == 0:
            scan_direction = (
                "SCAN_RIGHT" if scan_direction == "SCAN_LEFT" else "SCAN_LEFT"
            )
            memory["scan_direction"] = scan_direction
        memory["state"] = "SEARCH"
        return scan_direction, 0.75, memory

    if track_age < 2:
        memory["state"] = "VERIFY"
        return "SLOW_DOWN", 0.80, memory

    if distance == "near":
        if heading_error <= 12.0 and identity_confidence >= 0.80:
            memory["state"] = "ARRIVED"
            return "ARRIVED", 0.96, memory

        turn = "VEER_LEFT" if bearing < 0 else "VEER_RIGHT"
        last_turn = turn
        memory["last_turn"] = last_turn
        memory["state"] = "APPROACH"
        return turn, 0.88, memory

    # Use a wider deadband for stable forward motion and retain the prior
    # turn only when the target is nearly centered and no corridor is clear.
    if bearing < -12.0 and bool(observation["corridor_left"]):
        action, confidence = "VEER_LEFT", 0.90
    elif bearing > 12.0 and bool(observation["corridor_right"]):
        action, confidence = "VEER_RIGHT", 0.90
    elif bool(observation["corridor_center"]) and heading_error <= 25.0:
        action, confidence = "FORWARD", 0.92
    elif bool(observation["corridor_left"]):
        action, confidence = "VEER_LEFT", 0.82
    elif bool(observation["corridor_right"]):
        action, confidence = "VEER_RIGHT", 0.82
    else:
        memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
        return "STOP", 0.98, memory

    if action in {"VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT"}:
        last_turn = action
        memory["last_turn"] = last_turn
    memory["state"] = "APPROACH"
    return action, confidence, memory
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
